div.div: مُحَمْلِقٌ Eyes having around their globes a whiteness unmixed with blackness: [it would seem to be a mistranscription for مُحَمْلِقَةٌ; but perhaps it is an epithet applied to a man having eyes of this description; for it is immediately added,] whence عَيْنٌ مُحَمْلِقَةٌ [app. meaning an eye having around it such a whiteness]. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
